verdict.rationale: Radar surfaces ML-driven 'risk insights' explaining why a payment was flagged and 'fraud insights' analytics visualizing trends over time, which are data-derived insights from the product's own model, but there's no evidence of generative/LLM-style suggestions, natural-language explanations, or proactive recommendations beyond static risk-factor displays and dashboards. Missing for 10: generative/LLM-based insight summaries, proactive actionable suggestions (e.g., rule recommendations), and any independent corroboration of these insight features' usefulness.
